f.title: Missing semicolon
f.message: Statement is missing a semicolon at the end
f.fix: Add semicolon after the closing parenthesis: System.out.println("Hello, World!");

f.title: While loop missing braces
f.message: The while loop on line 14 has no braces, so only line 15 (println) is the loop body. Lines 16-19 (reading input, summing, incrementing count) execute once after the loop, causing an infinite loop since count never increments inside the loop.
f.fix: Add curly braces around the loop body: while (count < 5) { ... }

f.title: Case sensitivity error
f.message: Variable 'system' should be 'System' - Java is case-sensitive and 'System' is the correct class name for standard input
